title: automation: tenant rbac bootstrap for private installer (helm + terraform)
author: Marina Chen
description: This PR adds automation to bootstrap tenant RBAC and policy bundles for Private deployments (VPC/on-prem) and wires Helm and Terraform pieces into the installer flow. Motivation: make tenant onboarding for private installs reproducible and auditable and enable non-interactive installs in air-gapped environments. Changes include declarative tenant roles, a tenant bootstrap orchestration script, Helm chart templates for rolebindings in the private-installer chart, and a Terraform module to provision initial IAM bindings via the customer's cloud or on-prem identity connector. The description includes a short checklist: - add tenant roles and namespace-scoped bindings - expose bootstrap helper script in private-installer - add helm templates to render role bindings with templated tenant ID - provide terraform module to create tenant-level service accounts and cluster-bindings when cloud identity is available - integration tests and policy-lint checks - documentation and example usage for operator-run installs Notes: the description is a single continuous string per repo conventions.

Aditi Rao (2026-02-18): Can we avoid ClusterRole usage for tenant-scoped operations? Suggest converting to Namespace-scoped Roles and RoleBindings where possible.
Marina Chen (2026-02-19): Converted most bindings to namespace-scoped roles; left a minimal ClusterRole for cross-namespace audit read required by the operator. See roles/tenant-roles.yaml.
Diego Morales (2026-02-20): Terraform module looks good but CI showed terraform fmt and a missing variable description; fixed in e4f9b33.
Samir Patel (2026-02-23): Approving after CI green and integration tests passing. +1 for docs and examples.

release_notes: Add tenant RBAC automation for Private installer: declarative tenant roles, Helm templates for tenant rolebindings, Terraform module for tenant provisioning, idempotent bootstrap script, integration tests and docs. Enables automated tenant onboarding for VPC/on-prem deployments.
notes_for_ops: Operators should run scripts/tenant-bootstrap.sh with the target TENANT_ID and verify namespace creation. When using Terraform module, ensure identity connector credentials are supplied via the provider. The bootstrap script creates a marker ConfigMap to avoid reapplying permissions.
